_meta.notes: Absolute DALY counts. Values from Lancet GBD 2021 supplementary appendix Table eS2 (US) and disease-specific GBD publications. Refresh from https://vizhub.healthdata.org/gbd-results/ when IHME access is available.

Glioblastoma Multiforme.note: GBD 2021 brain/CNS cancer US: ~260K; GBM is ~84% of malignant brain tumors

Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.note: GBD 2021 pancreatic cancer US; one of fastest-rising cancer burdens

ALS (SOD1-mutant).note: GBD 2021 MND US; includes ALS, PLS, PMA — SOD1 is ~20% of familial ALS

Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales.note: Derived from CDC AR Threats 2022: ~13,300 deaths × ~24 DALY/death

Acinetobacter baumannii MDR.note: CDC AR 2022: ~700 deaths; HAI disability burden adds YLD component

Spinal Muscular Atrophy Type 2.note: GBD 2021 SMA US ~40K; Type 2 is ~65% of treated SMA burden

HER2-low Breast Cancer.note: GBD 2021 breast cancer US: ~2.1M DALYs; HER2-low is ~55% of all BC

KRAS G12C NSCLC.note: GBD 2021 lung cancer US: ~3.4M; NSCLC 85% × KRAS G12C 13% → ~375K

Huntington Disease.note: GBD 2021 Huntington US; ~30K diagnosed patients × ~1.5 avg DALY weight

Friedreich Ataxia.note: Estimated: ~15K US patients × 1.55 DALY/patient (severe disability weight)

C. difficile Infection.note: GBD 2021 CDI US; CDC: ~15K deaths/yr, plus recurrent infection disability

MRSA Skin Infections.note: GBD 2021 S. aureus US: ~750K DALYs; SSTI subset ~60%

Type 1 Diabetes (CGM/automated insulin).note: GBD 2021 T1D US; distinct from T2D (~5.2M DALYs)

Alzheimer Disease (early/MCI).note: GBD 2021; largest neurological burden in US; includes vascular dementia

Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension.note: Estimated: ~200K US PAH patients; moderate-severe disability weight ~0.49

Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.note: GBD 2021; ~20K US DMD patients; high disability weight (progressive)

Myelofibrosis JAK-resistant.note: Estimated: ~21K US MF patients; high disability weight (bone marrow failure)

Geographic Atrophy (dry AMD).note: GBD 2021 AMD US: ~650K total; GA is ~65% of AMD burden

Sickle Cell Disease (gene therapy).note: GBD 2021 SCD US; ~100K patients with high pain/crisis disability burden

RSV in elderly/immunocompromised.note: GBD 2021 RSV US; CDC: ~177K hospitalizations, 6-10K deaths in 65+ per year

Sepsis (AI early detection).note: GBD 2021; CDC ~270K sepsis deaths/yr × avg 4.9 DALY/death; major HAI burden

NASH/MASH.note: GBD 2021 NAFLD US; rising rapidly — 14% increase 2010-2019

Prostate Cancer (PSMA-targeted).note: GBD 2021 prostate cancer US; ~34K deaths/yr, large survivorship burden

Bipolar Depression.note: GBD 2021 bipolar US; ~6M patients, significant YLD-driven burden

Rare Pediatric Epilepsy (SCN1A).note: GBD 2021 epilepsy US ~700K; drug-resistant pediatric subset ~11%
